results.name: full snapshot roundtrips all supported sections and unfinished drafts
full backups accept multiple valid legacy drafts above the old single-file 1 MiB limit
unsafe, incomplete, unknown-version and oversized imports do not mutate any state
successful restore verifies all keys, retains exact prior originals and clears journal
backup/quota failure before transaction leaves every supported record intact
one failed write rolls back every changed key including originally absent keys
persistent write failure retains journal and restart restores exact old state
recovery refuses to overwrite a record changed since interruption
pending transaction prevents ordinary writers from touching supported data
malformed journal is retained without restoring arbitrary keys
